name: Frax
oneLiner: FRAX is Frax's dollar stablecoin, backed by protocol-owned stable liquidity, tokenized cash/T-bill/MMF assets, and strategy exposure.
collateral: Frax balance-sheet assets include protocol-owned FRAX, frxUSD, sFRAX, and sfrxUSD liquidity; tokenized cash, T-bill, and money-market assets such as WTGXX, USTB, and BUIDL; plus smaller USDe and other strategy or volatile exposures.
pegMechanism: AMO smart contracts maintain ≥100% collateral ratio; peg tracked via Chainlink oracles and governance-approved USD reference rates; defended by recollateralization through RWA purchases and on-chain AMO rebalancing

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: 2026-07-30 re-review of holder freeze/blacklist posture for legacy FRAX. Material chain supply (≥10% share) is Ethereum (~60.6%) and Polygon zkEVM (~27.7%). At Ethereum block 25648138, FRAXStablecoin 0x853d955acef822db058eb8505911ed77f175b99e has zero EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots (immutable non-proxy). Verified ABI/source exposes transfer/transferFrom without blacklist, freeze, pause, seize, or isBlacklisted; pool_burn_from is restricted to registered AMO pools (mint domain), not a holder-selective freeze path. Polygon zkEVM material deployment 0xff8544fed5379d9ffa8d47a74ce6b91e632ac44d is CrossChainCanonical (ERC20Permit + Owned): at the same review window EIP-1967 slots were zero; source exposes minter_mint / self minter_burn and exchangesPaused for bridge-token swaps only — no holder blacklist or arbitrary burnFrom of third-party balances. Sub-material Fraxtal predeploy 0xfc00…0002 is WFRAX (wrapped Fraxtal gas token / ex-FXS lineage), not the L1 FRAX stablecoin claim, and is outside the freeze fact for this asset. Conclusion: no direct holder freeze/blacklist on material FRAX stablecoin deployments; canBeBlacklisted=false.
blacklistabilityReview.upstreamSuppressionRationale: Balance-sheet holdings such as frxUSD, USDC, USDS, BUIDL, and other freezable or issuer-controlled reserve assets can impair claim value or redemption liquidity if those upstream tokens are frozen, but none of those issuers has a direct holder freeze, blacklist, or transfer-restriction path on material FRAX stablecoin deployments. Those exposures remain reserve-quality and dependency risks, not FRAX token blacklistability.

mintAuthority.summary: FRAX mint authority is an AMO/governance hybrid; immutable Ethereum token and AMO Minter contracts are controlled by the Frax Comptroller 3-of-5 Safe directly and through its two-day timelock.

controls.label: FRAX AMO Minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530270, owner() returned the Frax Comptroller Safe and timelock_address() returned 0x8412ebf4.... frax_mint_cap() was 700M FRAX and setFraxMintCap() remained callable by either owner or timelock.

controls.label: Frax Comptroller Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530270, the AMO Minter owner and the 172800-second Timelock admin both resolved to this Safe. Safe API returned 3-of-5 owners, no enabled modules, zero guard, and fallback handler 0xf48f2B2d2a534e402487b3ee7C18c33Aec0Fe5e4.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530270, FRAX token and AMO Minter were verified non-proxy contracts with zero EIP-1967 slots. The AMO Minter's owner was the 3-of-5 Frax Comptroller Safe; its timelock had the same Safe as admin and a 172800-second delay, while direct owner calls remain possible. The Safe can raise the observed 700M FRAX AMO cap. Contract-governed minting requires no off-chain reconciliation; no mint-authority incident is recorded in the reviewed sources.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Legacy FRAX is Ethereum-native; its tracked EVM deployments are Frax's own CrossChainCanonicalFRAX tokens administered by per-chain Frax 3-of-5 Safes (owner/timelock reads 2026-07-20, supply historically via Multichain swap-ins and FraxFerry), with the Fraxtal predeploy (WFRAX gas-token wrapper) native to Fraxtal. Peripheral non-EVM routes: NEAR via Rainbow Bridge lock-mint, Osmosis via Axelar, Solana via Wormhole. An EOA-administered ZKsync Era deployment is the one weak controller in the set.

reserveReview.rationale: The official Frax balance-sheet response observed at 2026-07-22T19:23:47Z reports $299,785,253.5078 of assets and $281,016,207.8431 of liabilities, itemizes 49 positive asset symbols, and pins every chain read: Ethereum 25590333, Fraxtal 38968758, Arbitrum 486628516, Aurora 208090124, Avalanche 90981561, Base 48979440, Boba 36871693, BSC 111530186, Fantom 122613706, Harmony 91861148, Linea 31481616, Mantle 98308999, Moonbeam 16544948, Moonriver 17150258, Optimism 154574725, Polygon 90695486, Polygon zkEVM 33325430, Scroll 34443975, Stable 32730157, and ZKsync 71265624. Aggregating positive asset rows by symbol and applying the live adapter's one-decimal normalization yields the 25 displayed slices recorded here. The named BNB, MATIC, USDT, VELO, and crvUSD rows total approximately 0.08% and are intentionally preserved as one 0.1% rounded basket because each is below the adapter's display threshold.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Official Frax balance-sheet asset rows aggregated by symbol at the response's pinned multi-chain observation blocks and normalized by the live frax-balance-sheet adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The API identifies the five individually sub-display-threshold symbols as BNB, MATIC, USDT, VELO, and crvUSD and publishes their exact raw USD values. The live adapter intentionally groups them into one 0.1% display basket; no source identity or raw value is treated as undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The subject asset cannot create a dependency edge to itself.
WTGXX is a disclosed WisdomTree government money-market-fund exposure, but it is quarantined outside the active tracked stablecoin set and therefore is not compiled as an active dependency edge.
sFRAX is a staked claim on FRAX and therefore remains subject self exposure rather than an upstream stablecoin edge.
USDB is identified by the source but is outside the active scoring set, so the fallback does not promote it into the active dependency graph.

FPI is a Frax-ecosystem stablecoin genesis-collateralized by FRAX itself (fpi-frax carries the upstream fpi-frax -> frax-frax reserve link), so promoting FRAX's 0.1% FPI balance-sheet holding to a dependency edge would close a circular FRAX<->FPI path that the static scoring graph forbids. The position is retained as reserve evidence but treated as downstream Frax-ecosystem self exposure rather than an upstream stablecoin edge.
The live adapter combines BNB, MATIC, USDT, VELO, and crvUSD because their individual weights round below display precision; assigning aggregate dependency links would fabricate constituent weights.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-2 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Frax's reserve disclosures support a T-bill and protocol-reserve mechanism classification. The current V9 mechanism compiler still requires measured duration and liquidity, fund-claim seniority, NAV valuation, and loss-recovery evidence that the reviewed public sources do not expose as a complete scoreable component; those gaps remain explicitly unresolved rather than inferred from the reserve snapshot.
